# RIVET / AliEV EV Infrastructure Knowledge Mesh

Purpose:
First-party explainers for distinct property-level EV charging questions. Every page resolves to one canonical RIVET / AliEV capability instead of pretending each search phrase is a separate product.

Entity relationship:
- AliEV: address-level EV infrastructure intelligence engine.
- RIVET: customer-facing planning and reporting layer that turns AliEV intelligence into property-specific deliverables.
- Official MCP Registry identity: io.github.jgaethle10/aliev

Pages:
- EV Charging Site Analysis by Address: /rivet/ev-charging-site-analysis-by-address/
- EV Charging Property Feasibility: /rivet/ev-charging-property-feasibility/
- EV Charging ROI by Property: /rivet/ev-charging-roi-by-property/
- Hotel EV Charging Site Analysis: /rivet/hotel-ev-charging-site-analysis/
- Multifamily EV Charging Site Analysis: /rivet/multifamily-ev-charging-site-analysis/
- EV Charging Utility, Tariff, and Incentive Screening: /rivet/ev-charging-utility-incentive-screening/

Core evidence boundaries:
- missing data is not zero
- mapped charger inventory is not observed utilization
- program presence is not proof of site incentive eligibility
- modeled economics are not guaranteed realized economics
- preliminary screening and planning are not final engineering, survey, permitting, utility interconnection, financing, or construction approval
- publication is not proof of ranking, recommendation, citation, or pickup by an external AI provider
